text.style: font-size: 18px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2d2e2d

g.text: Pension entitlements as a share of GDP

text.style: font-size: 11.52px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b5b5b

g.text: The value today of the pensions people have already earned in state, workplace, and private

text.style: font-size: 11.52px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b5b5b

g.text: schemes, as a share of GDP. Unfunded government schemes will pay them from future

text.style: font-size: 11.52px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5b5b5b

g.text: contributions and taxes; private and funded schemes mostly from savings set aside. Data for 2021.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585
font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: Eurostat values future pensions with a 4% discount rate, but 5% for Hungary and 4.5% for Poland, which lowers their values.

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: Austria’s total uses a different definition, and Germany’s figures are provisional. Romania is not shown, as it reports no total.

text.style: font-size: 8.64px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585
font-size: 7.92px; font-family: 'Lato', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #858585

g.text: OurWorldinData.org — Research and data to make progress against the world’s largest problems.
